text: In which landmark judgment delivered in 2016, did the Supreme Court issue guidelines on drought management to the Government of India?
option_a: Swaraj Abhiyan Vs Union of India
option_c: Common Cause Vs Union of India
option_d: Mahipal Singh Rana Vs State of UP
explanation: The Swaraj Abhiyan v. Union of India (2016) judgment laid down guidelines on drought management and relief.

text: Out of the following, which is not a power granted to Rajya Sabha?
option_a: Authorizing Parliament in the national interest to make a law on a matter in the State List
option_b: Authorizing State Assemblies in the national interest to make law on matters in the Union List
option_c: To return a Money Bill with recommendations
option_d: Authorizing Parliament in the national interest to make a law for creation of an All India Service
explanation: The Rajya Sabha can authorise Parliament (Arts 249, 312) to legislate on State List or create All-India Services, but it cannot authorise State Assemblies to legislate on the Union List.

text: Which of the following could be one of the reasons for pruning of development targets of the second five year plan?
option_a: Non-availability of foreign collaborators to set up heavy industries
option_d: Failure of bureaucracy to implement developmental schemes
explanation: The Second Plan's heavy-industry drive triggered a severe foreign-exchange crisis, forcing targets to be pruned.

text: Out of the options below, what was the issue of emphasis in the sixth five year plan put forward for 1978-83 by the Government of the Janata Party?
explanation: The Janata Government's 1978-83 rolling plan emphasised employment generation and removal of poverty.

text: From which five year plan was the system of setting "monitorable targets" for key indicators of development introduced?
explanation: The Tenth Plan (2002-07) introduced monitorable targets for key socio-economic indicators.

text: Which organization is entrusted with the initiative of converting 100% Government – Citizen transactions to the digital platform?
option_b: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
explanation: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) drives the Digital India goal of digitising government-to-citizen services.

text: Which of the following is not one of the subjects on which a sub group of chief ministers is constituted by NITI Aayog as part of Cooperative Federalism?
explanation: NITI Aayog constituted sub-groups of Chief Ministers on centrally sponsored schemes, skill development and Swachh Bharat; digital payments was handled by a separate later committee.

text: The debate between Bhagawati and Sen on the economic policy of India revolves on
option_b: Economic Growth first versus Investment in Social Infrastructure first
explanation: Bhagwati stressed growth-led development first; Sen stressed prior investment in social infrastructure (health, education).

text: The most important reason for higher absolute increase in urban population in India compared to rural population in the decade from 2001 to 2011 could be due to
option_a: migration from rural to urban areas
option_b: higher death rate in rural areas due to lesser access to medical facilities
option_c: better methods of birth control in rural areas
option_d: categorization of erstwhile rural areas as urban areas
explanation: A large part of the 2001-11 urban rise came from the reclassification of rural settlements as 'census towns'.

text: As per census 2011, between 2001 and 2011
option_a: farmers increased and farm labourers decreased
option_b: farmers increased and farm labourers increased
option_c: farmers decreased and farm labourers decreased
option_d: farmers decreased and farm labourers increased
explanation: Census 2011 showed a fall in the number of cultivators (farmers) and a rise in agricultural labourers.

text: As per the statistics of the National Crime Records Bureau (ADSI 2015), the biggest reason for suicide of farmers in India is
option_d: illness, drug abuse and alcohol addiction
explanation: ADSI 2015 attributed the largest share of farmer suicides to bankruptcy or indebtedness.

text: Which of the following is not a component of Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)?
explanation: PMKSY comprises AIBP, Har Khet ko Pani, Per Drop More Crop and Watershed Development; a National Water Grid is not a component.

text: The MOU to be signed by the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC) (approved by Union Cabinet in April, 2017) is on cooperation in
explanation: The BIMSTEC MoU approved in April 2017 was for grid interconnection in the power sector.

text: Which of the following is a demand side intervention in the UDAY (Ujjwal DISCOM Assurance Yojana) Scheme of the Central Government?
option_c: Usage of energy efficient LED bulbs
explanation: Promoting energy-efficient LED bulbs reduces demand — a demand-side measure under UDAY.

text: With regard to funding of the Polavaram Project, the Centre would provide
option_a: 100% of the cost of the irrigation component for the period starting from 01/04/2014 to the extent of the cost as on that date
option_b: 100% of the cost of the irrigation component as incurred
option_c: 100% of the cost of the irrigation component as per value decided by the Centre
option_d: 100% of the cost of the full project for the period starting from 01/04/2014 to the extent of the cost as on that date
explanation: Under the AP Reorganisation Act, the Centre funds 100% of the remaining cost of the irrigation component of Polavaram as on 01/04/2014.

text: The coach with glass roof and other facilities in the Visakhapatnam–Araku Train is known as
explanation: The glass-roofed tourist coach on the Visakhapatnam–Araku route is the Vistadome coach.

text: Which institute is the academic mentor for the Indian Institute of Petroleum and Energy (IIPE), Visakhapatnam?
option_a: Petroleum Conservation and Research Agency, Delhi
explanation: IIT Kharagpur was designated the academic mentor for IIPE Visakhapatnam.

text: Which of the following parameters had the highest weightage for calculating tax devolution from Centre to States as per the recommendations of the 14th Finance Commission?
explanation: The 14th Finance Commission gave the highest weight (50%) to income distance in the horizontal devolution formula.

text: Which year is taken as the basis for resources for making recommendations by the 14th Finance Commission?
explanation: The 14th Finance Commission departed from the base-year approach and did not adopt a base year for assessing resources.

text: Which of the following is one of the factors not considered by the 14th Finance Commission in vertical devolution of resources?
option_b: Concerns of States and Centre on fiscal space
option_c: Differential levels in aspirations and expectations of the population of various States
option_d: Need for clarity on functional and expenditure responsibilities of States and Centre in the interest of sound federal fiscal relations
explanation: Differential aspirations of populations relate to horizontal (inter-state) sharing, not to vertical (Centre-States) devolution.

text: Compositional shift from grants to tax devolution from Centre to State causes
option_a: additional fiscal burden on the Centre
option_b: increase in share of unconditional transfers to States
option_c: demand from States to increase tax rates
option_d: lack of fiscal space to carry out specific purpose transfer to States
explanation: Tax devolution is untied/unconditional, so shifting from grants to tax devolution raises the share of unconditional transfers to States.

text: The relationship in India between redistributive resource transfers from the Centre to States and various economic outcomes like per capita consumption, growth in GDP, tax revenue effort is
explanation: Studies cited by the 14th FC found redistributive transfers negatively correlated with outcomes such as own tax effort and growth.

text: Muga silk is a product of the silkworm endemic to which State of India?
explanation: Muga silk, the golden silk, is endemic to Assam.

text: As per the rationalization of Centrally Sponsored Schemes by the Government of India, "core of the core" schemes are
option_a: Social protection and Social inclusion schemes
option_b: Schemes which are part of National Agenda
explanation: 'Core of the Core' schemes are those for social protection and social inclusion of the most vulnerable (e.g., MGNREGA, umbrella SC/ST schemes).

text: What is the meaning of competitive sub-federalism in the context of achieving targets on social and developmental goals?
option_d: Local Bodies competing with Local Bodies
explanation: Competitive federalism refers to States competing with one another to attract investment and improve outcomes.

text: Which of the following programmes of the Government of India does not provide opportunity for urban rejuvenation?
explanation: The Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission targets rural clusters, not urban rejuvenation.

text: A recent radical idea to overcome the problem of poor targeting and misallocation of social welfare schemes is that of
option_c: Direct allocation of funds to Local Bodies
explanation: The Economic Survey 2016-17 floated Universal Basic Income as a radical alternative to poorly targeted welfare schemes.

text: What is the all India participation rate of Women in MNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Agency) Scheme in 2016 – 17?
explanation: Women's participation in MGNREGA in 2016-17 was about 56%.

text: The Inter State Council was established on the recommendations of
explanation: The Inter-State Council (1990) was set up on the recommendation of the Sarkaria Commission.

text: "Cooperative Federalism" in Centre – State relations is recommended for the first time by
explanation: The Sarkaria Commission first emphasised cooperative federalism in Centre-State relations.

text: Out of the following, which is a recommendation of the M.M. Punchhi Commission on the institution of Governor?
option_a: Provision for impeachment of the Governor may be introduced by the State Legislature
option_b: The system of Governor may be abolished
option_c: Consent of Chief Minister of a State shall be necessary before appointing Governor of the State
option_d: Governors should be periodically rotated between States
explanation: The Punchhi Commission recommended a provision for the impeachment of the Governor by the State Legislature.

text: Which of the following is a principle followed by the farmers who are participants to the APFAMGS (Andhra Pradesh Farmer Managed Groundwater Systems) Project?
option_b: Rules are set by users and not by outsiders
option_d: Fixed rules which are not amenable to change are made
explanation: APFAMGS follows the community-managed principle that rules for groundwater use are set by the users themselves.

text: What was the immediate cause for loss of foreign reserves triggering the financial crisis in 1991?
option_c: Sharp rise in value of imports of oil & petroleum products
option_d: Stoppage of rupee trade by the Soviet Bloc
explanation: The Gulf War (1990-91) caused a sharp rise in the value of oil imports, rapidly depleting India's forex reserves.

text: Which move helped to tide over the balance of payment crisis in 1991?
option_a: Sale of gold in international markets
option_b: Emergency loan from IMF by pledging gold reserves
explanation: India pledged gold reserves to raise an emergency loan from the IMF to overcome the 1991 BoP crisis.

text: Which of the following sectors was not much affected by the reforms after 1991?
explanation: Railways remained a government monopoly and was largely untouched by the post-1991 liberalisation.

text: What could be the main reason for jobless growth in the reform period after 1991?
option_a: Reforms were mainly confined to the formal sector
option_b: Majority of the labour force was already employed and hence there was no need for jobs
option_c: The informal sector opposed the reforms and new industries could not be opened
option_d: People were not willing to do menial jobs
explanation: Post-1991 reforms were largely confined to the organised/formal sector, which employs a small share of the workforce, leading to jobless growth.

text: Under the new Central GST Bill, 2017, the mechanism to monitor and ensure that any reduction in tax rate should result in a commensurate reduction in the price of goods or services is known as
explanation: The anti-profiteering measure ensures the benefit of a tax-rate cut is passed on to consumers via lower prices.

text: Under the scheme of new GST Bills, 2017, subject to a ceiling fixed under GST Act, the changes in GST rates can normally be effected by
option_b: Government with prior approval of President
explanation: Within the ceiling set by the Act, GST rates are changed by the Government through notification, on the GST Council's recommendation.

text: Under the GST (Compensation to States) Bill, 2017, the unutilized money in the GST Compensation Fund at the end of five years would be
option_a: Distributed amongst States as per the formula prescribed by the Finance Commission for devolution of taxes
option_b: Shared equally between the Centre and States with apportionment amongst the States on the basis of SGST collection in the last year of transition
option_d: Shared equally between the Centre and States with apportionment amongst the States on the basis of the formula prescribed by the Finance Commission for devolution of taxes
explanation: Any unutilised amount is shared 50:50 between the Centre and the States, the States' share being apportioned by SGST collection in the last transition year.

text: Out of the options below, the most important disadvantage of a multiple tax rate structure is
option_a: Difficulty in remembering rates for different items
option_b: Cross subsidization amongst the taxes on different items
option_d: Difficulty in arriving at a tax rate for an item
explanation: Multiple rates create incentives and disputes over misclassification of goods and services into lower-taxed categories.

text: Out of the options below, who was awarded the Pulitzer Prize in 2017 for Explanatory Journalism?
explanation: The 2017 Pulitzer Prize for Explanatory Reporting went to the ICIJ (with partners) for the Panama Papers investigation.

text: Who is the winner of the recently held Superseries Singapore Open Badminton title in the Men's Singles category?
explanation: B. Sai Praneeth won the 2017 Singapore Open Men's Singles title, beating Kidambi Srikanth in the final.

text: As stated in the Economic Survey 2016 – 17, what is the potential consequence experienced by a majority of women in a household not having toilets?
option_c: Travelling long distance for toilet facility
explanation: The Economic Survey noted that women without household toilets often reduce their water intake to avoid the need to defecate in the open.

text: In the case of PDS schemes, which would be the probable relation between coverage and leakage?
option_a: The lower the coverage, the higher the leakage
option_b: The lower the coverage, the lower the leakage
option_c: The higher the coverage, the higher the leakage
option_d: There is no relation between coverage and leakage
explanation: Evidence shows wider PDS coverage tends to reduce leakage; hence lower coverage is associated with higher leakage.

text: Which one of the following is the most effective financial inclusion programme?
explanation: The Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana, by opening bank accounts for the unbanked, is the flagship financial-inclusion programme.

text: A large gap in the collection of property tax vis-a-vis the potential tax of Bengaluru city as shown in the Economic Survey for 2016 – 17 is estimated from
option_c: Fall in the number of existing taxpayers
option_d: Increase in the number of building permissions
explanation: The Economic Survey 2016-17 used satellite imagery to estimate the shortfall in Bengaluru's property-tax collection.

text: As per the Manual for Drought Management, 2016 published by the Union Ministry of Agriculture, an area which is classified as "chronically drought prone" receives mean annual rainfall which is less than
explanation: Areas with mean annual rainfall below 750 mm are classified as chronically drought-prone.

text: Which of the following is not a parameter used by the The Crop Weather Watch Group constituted by Government of India to monitor the drought situation in the country?
explanation: The Crop Weather Watch Group monitors meteorological, hydrological and agricultural parameters, not geological ones.

text: What is the cause of earthquakes in the region from the Himalayas to the Arakan Yoma?
option_a: Collision of Pacific Plate and Indian Plate
option_b: Collision of Indian Plate and Tibetan Plate
option_c: Collision of Eurasian Plate and Indian Plate
option_d: Construction of dams on the Ganga and Brahmaputra
explanation: The Himalaya–Arakan Yoma belt is seismically active due to the collision of the Indian and Eurasian plates.

text: Out of the events given below, which is the most important cause of Tsunami?
option_a: Fault movement on the sea floor
explanation: Most tsunamis are generated by fault movement (vertical displacement) on the sea floor during undersea earthquakes.

text:
Match the following traditional water harvesting systems with the region in which they are followed:
A. Zing  I. Tamil Nadu
B. Zabo  II. Rajasthan
C. Johads  III. Ladakh
D. Phad  IV. Maharashtra
E. Yeri  V. Nagaland
explanation: Zing are meltwater channels of Ladakh, Zabo is a rainwater/runoff system of Nagaland, Johads are check dams of Rajasthan, Phad is a channel-irrigation system of Maharashtra, and Yeri (tanks) belong to Tamil Nadu — i.e. A-III, B-V, C-II, D-IV, E-I.

text: Out of the items given below, what is Korambu?
option_a: Temporary wall of brushwood, grass and mud laid across channels to raise the level of water in use in Kerala
option_b: A runoff farming and groundwater recharging system of Rajasthan
option_c: A traditional step well of Tamil Nadu
option_d: A system of channels built to intercept and collect rainwater in Nagaland
explanation: Korambu is a temporary brushwood-and-mud check dam used in Kerala to raise water levels in channels.

text: Which of the following is a traditional method of conservation of tree cover across communities in India?
explanation: Sacred groves are patches of forest protected by local communities on religious grounds — a traditional, community-based method of conserving tree cover.

text: In ecosystem terminology, who are the major producers in a terrestrial ecosystem?
explanation: In a terrestrial ecosystem the primary producers are green plants (herbaceous and woody plants) that fix energy through photosynthesis; phytoplankton are the producers in aquatic ecosystems.

text: Out of the below mentioned persons, who was appointed as Messenger of Peace by the UNO in April, 2017?
explanation: Malala Yousafzai was designated a United Nations Messenger of Peace on 10 April 2017, the highest UN honour for a civilian.

text: For the purpose of reducing wind forces on the roof during a cyclone, the best roof architecture of a building, out of the options below is
explanation: A hip roof slopes on all four sides, giving it better aerodynamic behaviour and lower wind uplift than gable, pyramidal or flat roofs; it is recommended for cyclone-prone areas.

text: What is the objective of the Appiko movement?
option_a: To construct check dams to conserve water
option_b: To construct steel bridges in rural areas
explanation: The Appiko movement (Karnataka, 1983), inspired by the Chipko movement, was launched to protect forests from commercial felling.

text: For which area was H.R.H. Princess Maha Chakri Sirindhorn awarded the Padma Bhushan?
explanation: Princess Maha Chakri Sirindhorn of Thailand received the Padma Bhushan (2017) in the field of Literature & Education.

text: Ganjam Venkatasubbaiah, who was awarded the Padma Shri is known for his work as a/an
explanation: G. Venkatasubbaiah was a renowned Kannada lexicographer, grammarian and critic who compiled major Kannada dictionaries.

text: How many persons were awarded the Padma Shri in 2017 in the Sports category?
explanation: In 2017 the Padma Shri was conferred on eight sportspersons (including P.V. Sindhu, Sakshi Malik, Dipa Karmakar and para-athletes), the largest sports contingent that year.

text: How many national missions have been started as part of the National Action Plan on Climate Change?
explanation: The National Action Plan on Climate Change (2008) comprises eight national missions covering solar, energy efficiency, sustainable habitat, water, Himalayan ecosystem, green India, sustainable agriculture and strategic knowledge.

text: What is the capacity of solar power sought to be installed in India by 2022 under the Jawaharlal Nehru National Solar Mission?
explanation: The Jawaharlal Nehru National Solar Mission target was revised to 100 GW of installed solar capacity by 2022.

text: Which number does one have to call in Andhra Pradesh to utilize the services of Talli Bidda Express?
explanation: Talli Bidda Express (the free transport service ferrying mother and newborn home from hospital) is availed by calling 102 in Andhra Pradesh; 108 is the emergency ambulance number.

text: What is the objective of the "Badikosta" scheme started by the Government of Andhra Pradesh?
option_a: To minimize dropout rate of girl students from high school
option_b: To promote bicycle as a mode of environmentally-friendly transport for students
option_c: To provide bicycles at low cost to girl students
option_d: To provide incentive to teachers for getting girl students enrolled in school
explanation: The Badikosta ("coming to school") scheme distributed free bicycles to high-school students to reduce the dropout rate, especially among girls.

text: As per the expectations of ISRO, which rocket would be a "game changer" in the operations of ISRO?
explanation: ISRO described the GSLV-Mk-III-D1 (which placed GSAT-19 in orbit in June 2017) as a game changer, as it doubled the payload India could launch to geostationary transfer orbit.

text: National Science Day is celebrated in India on 28 February to mark the
option_a: Discovery of life in plants by J.C. Bose
option_d: Discovery of "Raman Effect" by C.V. Raman
explanation: National Science Day is observed on 28 February to commemorate the discovery of the Raman Effect by Sir C.V. Raman in 1928, for which he won the Nobel Prize in 1930.

text: Out of the options below, which types of activities are taken up under the Neeru Chettu programme by Government of AP?
option_b: Desiltation of minor irrigation tanks and channels
option_c: Development of parks and community groves
explanation: The Neeru-Chettu ("water and tree") programme centres on water conservation — chiefly desiltation and restoration of minor irrigation tanks and channels — alongside plantation.

text: After reorganization of Andhra Pradesh, which of the following organizations is established to act as a catalyst to facilitate economic growth and investment in Andhra Pradesh?
explanation: The Andhra Pradesh Economic Development Board (APEDB) was set up after bifurcation as the nodal agency to attract investment and catalyse economic growth in the state.

text: What is the target ratio set by SDG for reduction in poverty level by 2030?
option_d: There should be no poverty in any form
explanation: Sustainable Development Goal 1 aims to end poverty in all its forms everywhere by 2030 — not merely to lower it to a fixed ratio.

text: Who discovered the TB Bacillus?
explanation: Robert Koch identified Mycobacterium tuberculosis (the TB bacillus) in 1882, a discovery for which he later received the Nobel Prize.

text:
Match the following:
A. Malaria  P. Bone marrow
B. Filaria  Q. Brain
C. Encephalitis  R. Blood cells
D. Leukaemia  S. Lymph nodes
explanation: Malaria attacks the red blood cells, filaria affects the lymph nodes/lymphatic system, encephalitis is inflammation of the brain, and leukaemia is a cancer of the bone marrow — i.e. A-R, B-S, C-Q, D-P.

text: Which of the following crops is generally cultivated by transplanting seedlings?
explanation: Onion is typically raised in a nursery and then transplanted; maize, carrot and soyabean are directly sown.

text: Which of the following is associated with Diabetes Mellitus?
option_a: High sugar level and high insulin level in blood
option_b: High sugar level and low insulin level in blood
option_c: Low sugar level and high insulin level in blood
option_d: Low sugar level and low insulin level in blood
explanation: Diabetes mellitus is marked by high blood sugar arising from insufficient insulin (low insulin) or insulin resistance.

text: A diode is used for
explanation: A diode conducts current in only one direction, so it is used to rectify alternating current (AC) into direct current (DC).

text: Which of the following is used as a trigger in a nuclear bomb?
explanation: A krytron is a fast, high-voltage gas-filled switching tube capable of the precise, near-simultaneous detonation needed to trigger a nuclear device.

text: Which of the following enzyme found in tears destroys bacteria?
explanation: Tears contain the enzyme lysozyme (given here as "Lysosome"), which breaks down bacterial cell walls and provides antibacterial protection to the eye.

text: In eye donation, which part of the eye of the donor is utilized?
explanation: Eye (corneal) donation uses the cornea — the transparent front layer of the eye — which is transplanted to restore sight in the recipient.

text: Washing soap produces a scum with hard water and not much foam because the hard water contains
explanation: Hard water contains dissolved calcium and magnesium salts that react with soap to form an insoluble scum, reducing lather.

text:
Read the following and answer:
A team of five members is to be formed from five boys Pradip, Quddus, Rajesh, Samir and Tony and four girls Anusha, Bhagya, Chinmayi and Durga. The conditions are as follows: Pradip and Samir have to be together. Quddus cannot remain with Bhagya or Chinmayi. Rajesh and Anusha have to be together. Tony cannot remain with Anusha or Durga.

If Quddus is one of the members, who are the other members of the team?
explanation: With Quddus in, he cannot join Bhagya or Chinmayi; the only team satisfying Pradip-Samir together and Rajesh-Anusha together is Quddus, Anusha, Pradip, Rajesh, Samir.

text:
Read the following and answer:
A team of five members is to be formed from five boys Pradip, Quddus, Rajesh, Samir and Tony and four girls Anusha, Bhagya, Chinmayi and Durga. The conditions are as follows: Pradip and Samir have to be together. Quddus cannot remain with Bhagya or Chinmayi. Rajesh and Anusha have to be together. Tony cannot remain with Anusha or Durga.

If three members of the team are girls, then the team would be
explanation: Three girls plus two boys forces the boys to be Pradip and Samir (together); Anusha would drag in Rajesh, so the girls must be Bhagya, Chinmayi and Durga — i.e. Bhagya, Chinmayi, Durga, Pradip, Samir.

text:
Read the following and answer:
A team of five members is to be formed from five boys Pradip, Quddus, Rajesh, Samir and Tony and four girls Anusha, Bhagya, Chinmayi and Durga. The conditions are as follows: Pradip and Samir have to be together. Quddus cannot remain with Bhagya or Chinmayi. Rajesh and Anusha have to be together. Tony cannot remain with Anusha or Durga.

If Anusha is one member of the team and all others are boys, then the four boys would be
explanation: Anusha needs Rajesh, and Tony cannot be with Anusha, so Tony is out; with Pradip-Samir together the four boys are Pradip, Quddus, Rajesh, Samir.

text:
Read the following and answer:
A team of five members is to be formed from five boys Pradip, Quddus, Rajesh, Samir and Tony and four girls Anusha, Bhagya, Chinmayi and Durga. The conditions are as follows: Pradip and Samir have to be together. Quddus cannot remain with Bhagya or Chinmayi. Rajesh and Anusha have to be together. Tony cannot remain with Anusha or Durga.

If two members of the team are girls, then which of the following teams is not possible?
explanation: In Chinmayi, Durga, Pradip, Rajesh, Samir, Rajesh is present without Anusha, violating the rule that Rajesh and Anusha must stay together; hence this team is not possible.

text: Which of the following items is recently registered as a geographical indication from Andhra Pradesh?
explanation: Banaganapalle (Bangenapalli) mangoes of Andhra Pradesh received the Geographical Indication tag in 2017.

text: Out of the following, which parameter is given higher ranking weight by the National Institutional Ranking Framework of MHRD for awarding overall rank to educational institutions?
explanation: Among these, Research and Professional Practice carries the highest NIRF weight (0.30), ahead of Graduation Outcomes (0.20), Perception (0.10) and Outreach & Inclusivity (0.10).

text: The recent order of the Union Home Ministry on sharing of assets of APSCHE specifies that
option_a: Assets and liabilities are to shared in 52 : 48 ratio
option_b: Assets belong to the State of their location but cash deposits/balances to be shared in 52 : 48 ratio
option_c: Assets belong to the State of their location but cash deposits/balances to be shared in equal ratio
option_d: All assets belong to the State of Telangana
explanation: The order followed the reorganisation principle that immovable assets stay with the state where they are located, while cash deposits/balances are apportioned between Andhra Pradesh and Telangana in the 52 : 48 ratio.
